Google is testing moving the citations or sources icons to the very bottom of the AI Overviews. Previously, these icons appeared at the top of the AI Overview; now Google is testing placing them at the bottom, which may make it even harder to find the sources of the answers Google generates in these AI Overviews and could reduce clicks to your site even more.
This was spotted by Brodie Clark who wrote on X, "Google is now testing out the placement of the number of sites referenced within AI overviews at the bottom of the response. " "The previous placement for this experiment was at the top of the AI overview (directly above the citations). This version is different: hovering displays the full list of citations," he added. He also posted this on SERP Alert.
